rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for sound that is excessively loud.

example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 laa3 baa1 zan1 hai6 daai6 sing1

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on disruptive noise from a person, place, or event.

example.english: The building next door is so loud that I can't sleep.
example.traditional: 隔離棟樓嘈到我瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: gaak3 lei4 dung3 lau4 cou4 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this for someone who is conspicuously outspoken, attention-seeking, or unreserved.

example.english: They were loud and attention-seeking when they announced that they were dating.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gou1 diu6 gam2 syun1 bou3 paak3 to1

rows.note: Use this for clothes, colours, or patterns that are garish and tastelessly showy.

example.english: Their shirt is loud and really hard to match.
example.traditional: 佢件衫花哩碌咁，真係好難襯。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gin6 saam1 faa1 lei1 luk1 gam2 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 can3
